context: Saturday morning in a family kitchen. Mom is packing lunch, Dad is on the floor with the cat, and the eight-year-old has just noticed something missing.
purpose: domestic comedy / shared problem-solving — light family warmth

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Mild morning urgency from an eight-year-old. Voice lifts at the end. Not yet upset — just locating an adult to delegate to.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うさぎ？昨日どこに置いたの？
lines.en: Your bunny? Where did you put it yesterday?
lines.style: Practiced mom-tone. Half-listening, hands still working. The question is gentle but already redirecting the search back to the kid.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: わかんない！本当にないんだもん。
lines.en: I dunno! It's really not anywhere.
lines.style: Volume up half a notch. A tiny stamp inside the voice. Borderline tears but not crossed yet.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ちょっと見てごらん、テレビの後ろ。多分そこにあるよ。
lines.en: Take a look behind the TV. It's probably there.
lines.style: Warm, calm, half-laughing. The voice of someone who has run this exact rescue before. From floor level, unhurried.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Pure relief, sharp lift on 「あっ」, then quieter, almost embarrassed by her own panic.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ね、また同じところでしょ。何回言ったか。
lines.en: See? Same place as always. How many times have I said it.
lines.style: Half-smile in the tone. Light teasing, no edge. The 「ね」 is the warm I-told-you-so.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 見つけたら、ありがとうって言う人になろうね、ひな。
lines.en: When you find it, you say 'thank you' — that kind of person, okay Hina?
lines.style: Mock-serious, eyebrows raised in the voice. The dad-joke energy of someone fishing for affection.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Loud, theatrical, performing it back at him. Both of them in on the bit. JP and EN: same lifted-up performance.
